newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher boosted by foreign buyers.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher boosted by foreign buyers.

text.p: MADRID, Aug 27 (Reuter) 1520 GMT - Shares prices in Madrid closed higher on Tuesday in moderate volume, amid bond gains and buying by foreign investors, dealers said.

Sentiment was boosted by news the government is considering a cut in spending in real terms in 1997, and that support for the budget seemed likely. But dealers said the tone may be cautious until specific budget details emerge.
* General index up 2.50 points, 0.70 percent, to 357.81
* Repsol added 60 pesetas to 4,100, recovering part of a long run of losses ahead of first half results.
* Cepsa shed 110 pesetas to 3,850 after announcing a 20 pct fall in first half profit.
